title: Missing negative GCM auth tag tests: corruption, reject, reset-reuse
description: Test coverage gap: (1) no negative test corrupts the 12-byte tag and asserts -EBADMSG — without this the suite cannot distinguish an authenticating GCM from one that ignores the tag; (2) no set_tag rejection test for taglen < 12; (3) no sess_reset-then-reuse sequence verifying authsize is restored. Add these to tests/userspace/test_chardev.c (for kcapi) and tests/kernel/test_aead.c.
close_reason: 3 new negative tests: 12-byte tag corruption→EBADMSG, set_tag(11)→EINVAL, reset restores authsize
